text: Adele Fiona Boone, an Electrical Engineer, had a flagged week due to unusual evidence. The triggered rules point to two main findings: first, her logon volume outside working hours was significantly higher than usual; and second, she visited job-search sites atypical for her role. Specifically, there were 4 logons outside normal hours (compared to 0.5 on average in the past), and 70 visits to job-search sites (far above her typical 36 and even higher than the peer range of 8).
